title: Spontaneous breathing trials for adults on the ventilator
applies: Adults on mechanical ventilation. Every recommendation in this guideline is conditional: the guideline itself says different choices will suit different patients.

source.title: AARC Clinical Practice Guideline: Spontaneous Breathing Trials for Liberation From Adult Mechanical Ventilation
source.citation: Roberts KJ, Goodfellow LT, Battey-Muse CM, et al. Respir Care. 2024;69(7):891-901
source.rights: Copyright © 2024 Daedalus Enterprises. Department Hub holds none of its text; read it in your own copy (AARC members have access).

current.how: PubMed, searched 2026-11-12 for AARC clinical practice guidelines on spontaneous breathing trials: this 2024 guideline is the only one, none newer.

fields.about: a rapid shallow breathing index is not needed to decide readiness for a breathing trial

cards.title: Pressure support or T-piece for a breathing trial

fields.about: a breathing trial can be done with or without low-level pressure support of 8 cm H2O or less

cards.title: When in the day to do a breathing trial

fields.about: a standard daily assessment of readiness, and the trial itself when appropriate, done before noon
FIO2 should not be raised during a breathing trial

cards.title: Oxygenation commonly required before a breathing trial

fields.what: Oxygenation commonly required before a breathing trial
fields.value: SpO2 > 90% on FIO2 0.40, or PaO2/FIO2 > 200 mm Hg
fields.when: as the guideline describes common practice; it does not set this threshold

cards.title: Oxygen saturation at which a breathing trial is commonly stopped

fields.what: Commonly, a breathing trial is stopped and support resumed if
fields.when: as the guideline describes common practice in the trials it reviewed

cards.title: Breathing trial for a patient going to NIV after extubation

fields.what: Common post-extubation NIV settings, described by the guideline as anecdotal
fields.value: PSV 5–8 cm H2O and PEEP 5 cm H2O
fields.when: for these patients the guideline finds it reasonable to run the trial on those settings
